title: verbena lasiostachys var. abramsii
intro: Verbena lasiostachys var. abramsii, commonly known as a variant of the fragrant verbena plant, is a species of flowering plant in the Verbenaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and aid in sleep. The health benefits of Verbena lasiostachys var. abramsii include its potential to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
